How to play

  • Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over.
  • Aces count 1 or 11. Face cards count 10.
  • Blackjack pays 3 to 2. The dealer stands on all 17s.
  • Bet limit is 1,000 per play. Double doubles your bet for exactly one more card.
